title: Three-Way Word Embeddings for Polingual
abstract: Script, phonetic, meaning and joint embeddings for 529,131 words of 29 languages, and a meaning re-ranked lexicon that raises held-out first-sense precision from 58.0% to 68.3%.

data_sources.label: language graph data from dataset v1 embeddings
